name: qamdemod
expr: x16 = qamdemod(qammod(0:15, 16), 16); rt16 = double(isequal(x16(:).', 0:15)); x8 = qamdemod(qammod(0:7, 8), 8); rt8 = double(isequal(x8(:).', 0:7)); xb = qamdemod(qammod(0:15, 16, 'bin'), 16, 'bin'); rtb = double(isequal(xb(:).', 0:15));
comment: Sig: x = qamdemod(y, M[, order]). Nearest-point hard demod, inverse of qammod (col = round((I+KI-1)/2) gray-decoded, row = round((KQ-1-Q)/2) gray-decoded, s = col*KQ+row). Verified by exact round-trip qamdemod(qammod(0:M-1,M),M) == 0:M-1 for M=16 (square, gray), M=8 (rectangular), and M=16 'bin'.
